About the 34th Avenue Citi Bike Weekly Ride group ride

34th Avenue Citi Bike Weekly Ride is a social group ride in Jackson Heights, NY. It rolls every Saturday at 10:00 am from Citi Bike station, 34th Avenue between 93rd & 94th Streets.

A beginner group ride led by the 34th Avenue Open Streets Coalition. You can ride a Citi Bike at no charge. No sign-up; just show up. You need to already know how to ride. The schedule on Citi Bike's page was last posted for the 2025 season, so check the coalition's Instagram before you go.
